== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タッグ・シーカー</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-160o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォースを消費して移動させることができる。タッグまたは能力値＜３の戦士と同じ場所についたら、そのうち１枚を選んで、ロストデッキへ送る。タッグ・シーカーもロストデッキに行く。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Tagge Seeker.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy to your opponent's side of an unoccupied site. During your control phase, you may use Force to move it like a character. If it reaches the same location as Tagge or a warrior with ability below 3, choose one such card and send it to the Lost Pile. Tagge Seeker is also lost.

'''Lore:''' A military remote programmed to track particular people or pursue targets that meet specified conditions. Thermo-optical sensors let it track a target with great precision. It can also be slipped aboard a starship.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
